name: Sparkling Wine
description: Any wine made sparkling by bottle or tank fermentation, from Champagne and Prosecco to cava and cremant. Used to top spritzes, French 75s and other long drinks.

name: Champagne
description: Sparkling wine from the Champagne region of France, made by the traditional method from Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay. The classic top for a French 75 or Champagne Cocktail.

name: Prosecco
match: Prosecco or Other Dry Sparkling Wine, To Top
description: Italian tank-method sparkling wine, usually from Glera grapes in Veneto or Friuli. Dry to off-dry, with pear and white-flower notes, and the base of an Aperol Spritz.

name: Cava
description: Spanish traditional-method sparkling wine, mostly from Catalonia, based on Macabeo, Parellada and Xarel-lo. A dry, affordable stand-in for Champagne in cocktails and by the glass.

name: White Wine
description: Still wine made from white grapes, ranging from bone dry to sweet. Used in sangria, spritzes, wine cocktails and as a cooking and reduction base behind the bar.

name: Dry White Wine
description: White wine with little residual sugar, often crisp and high in acidity. The usual choice when a recipe calls for white wine in a punch, spritz or reduction.

name: Red Wine
description: Still wine made from dark-skinned grapes, from light and fruity to full and tannic. Used in sangria, New York Sours, mulled wine and other red-wine cocktails.

name: Rosé Wine
description: Still wine with pale pink colour from short skin contact with red grapes. Dry Provencal styles are common in spritzes, sangria and summer wine cocktails.

name: Sauternes
description: Sweet white wine from Sauternes in Bordeaux, made from botrytised Semillon and Sauvignon Blanc. Honeyed and apricot-like, used in dessert drinks and as a float.

name: Moscato
description: Aromatic wine from Muscat grapes, often lightly sparkling and low in alcohol, with grape and peach perfume. Poured in spritzes and sweet wine cocktails.

name: Lambrusco
description: Lightly sparkling red (sometimes rosato or white) wine from Emilia-Romagna, based on Lambrusco grapes. Fruity and refreshing, used in spritzes and casual wine serves.

name: Orange Wine
description: White grapes fermented on their skins, giving amber colour, tannin and dried-fruit flavour. Used when a recipe wants texture beyond ordinary white wine.

name: Ice Wine
description: Sweet dessert wine from grapes frozen on the vine, concentrated in sugar and acidity. Used sparingly in dessert cocktails and as a sweet wine float.

name: Cremant
description: French traditional-method sparkling wine made outside Champagne, often from Loire, Alsace or Burgundy grapes. A drier, food-friendly top for spritzes and French 75s.

name: Moët & Chandon Impérial
description: Non-vintage brut Champagne blending Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay. Bright apple and citrus with a soft mousse; a global bar and restaurant staple.

name: Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label
description: Non-vintage brut Champagne led by Pinot Noir, known for its yellow label. Full and toasty with stone fruit; poured widely at celebrations and in hotel bars.

name: Bollinger Special Cuvée
description: Pinot-led non-vintage Champagne aged longer than many peers, with toast, brioche and red-fruit depth. A favourite for Champagne cocktails and fine-dining lists.

name: Taittinger Brut Réserve
description: Chardonnay-forward non-vintage Champagne with citrus, white flowers and a fine bead. A clean, elegant house pour for aperitif and French 75 service.

name: Pol Roger Réserve
description: Balanced non-vintage Champagne of Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay. Fresh orchard fruit with fine bubbles; long associated with British state occasions.

name: Louis Roederer Collection
description: The house multi-vintage brut that replaced Brut Premier, blending Pinot Noir and Chardonnay with reserve wines. Precise citrus and chalk for serious lists.

name: Perrier-Jouët Grand Brut
description: Floral non-vintage Champagne with a high Chardonnay share. Light citrus and white-flower perfume; the everyday bottling behind the house flower bottle.

name: Laurent-Perrier La Cuvée
description: Chardonnay-led non-vintage Champagne, fresh and precise with citrus and white fruit. A clean aperitif style that also works well in Champagne cocktails.

name: Laurent-Perrier Cuvée Rosé
description: Saignée Champagne rose in the squat bottle, all Pinot Noir. Bright red berries and a dry finish; a bar and brunch favourite by the glass.

name: Piper-Heidsieck Cuvée Brut

name: Piper-Heidsieck Essentiel

name: Charles Heidsieck Brut Réserve

name: Billecart-Salmon Brut Rosé

name: Ruinart Blanc de Blancs

description: Martinborough Pinot Noir, fragrant cherry and savoury depth. A benchmark New Zealand Pinot for fine-dining lists.

name: Villa Maria Private Bin Pinot Noir
description: Approachable Marlborough Pinot Noir, red berry and soft tannin. A mid-price NZ Pinot for by-the-glass programmes.
image_query: Villa Maria Private Bin Pinot Noir bottle

name: Oyster Bay Pinot Noir
description: Volume Marlborough Pinot with cherry fruit and a smooth finish. Common alongside the brand Sauvignon Blanc on casual lists.

name: Kanonkop Kadette Cape Blend
description: Stellenbosch blend led by Pinotage with Cabernet and others, dark fruit and smoke. A gateway Cape red for restaurant pours.

name: Boekenhoutskloof The Chocolate Block
description: Syrah-led Cape blend with Grenache and others, dark berry and spice. A modern South African red hit on international lists.

name: Apothic Red
description: Sweet-leaning California red blend with dark berry and vanilla. A major US retail and casual-dining brand despite critic disdain.

name: 19 Crimes Red Blend
description: Australian red blend aimed at younger drinkers, ripe fruit and soft tannin. High retail volume with strong bar and casual presence.

name: Yellow Tail Shiraz
description: Entry Australian Shiraz with ripe berry and soft finish. One of the world's highest-volume wine brands in retail.

name: Barefoot Cabernet Sauvignon
description: Value California Cabernet for casual service, soft black fruit. Ubiquitous in retail and low-price on-premise accounts.

name: Jacob's Creek Classic Shiraz
description: Large-brand Australian Shiraz, plum and spice for everyday drinking. A long-standing export red in the UK and Asia.

name: Campo Viejo Reserva
description: Rioja reserva Tempranillo with cherry, vanilla and coconut oak. A high-volume Spanish red on UK and US casual lists.

name: Faustino I Gran Reserva
description: Long-aged Rioja gran reserva in the distinctive bottle, dried cherry and leather. A classic celebratory Spanish red.

name: Radikon Oslavje
description: Skin-contact white blend from Friuli's Oslavia hills, amber colour with tannin and dried fruit. A reference for serious orange wine lists.

name: Gravner Ribolla Gialla
description: Long skin-macerated Ribolla aged in amphora, deep amber and savoury. A landmark orange wine for natural-leaning lists.

name: La Stoppa Ageno
description: Skin-macerated Malvasia blend from Emilia, deep amber with orange peel and tannin. A widely cited Italian orange wine for bar and restaurant lists.

name: COS Pithos Bianco
description: Sicilian skin-contact white aged in amphora, mainly Grecanico, with apricot and herbal grip. A southern Italian orange wine for natural lists.

name: Château d'Yquem
description: Premier cru superieur Sauternes from botrytised Semillon and Sauvignon, honey and apricot. The world's most famous sweet white wine.

name: Château Rieussec
description: First-growth Sauternes owned by the Lafite group, honeyed citrus and saffron. A more attainable benchmark Sauternes than Yquem.

name: Royal Tokaji Gold Label 5 Puttonyos
description: Hungarian Aszu Tokaji at 5 puttonyos, orange marmalade and honey with vivid acidity. The modern face of Tokaji on export lists.
image_query: Royal Tokaji Gold Label 5 Puttonyos bottle

name: Inniskillin Vidal Icewine
description: Canadian Vidal ice wine from Niagara, mango, apricot and honey with piercing acidity. The reference New World ice wine brand.

name: Braida Brachetto d'Acqui
description: Lightly sparkling sweet Brachetto from Acqui, rose and strawberry perfume at low alcohol. A classic Italian dessert wine by the glass.

name: De Bortoli Noble One
description: Botrytis Semillon from the Riverina, apricot and honey with balancing acidity. Australia's best-known sticky dessert wine.

name: Kracher Beerenauslese Cuvée
description: Austrian sweet wine from botrytised grapes near Lake Neusiedl, tropical fruit and honey. A top modern sweet-wine producer for lists.

name: Château Suduiraut
description: First-growth Sauternes with pineapple, honey and saffron notes. A classic Bordeaux sweet white for restaurant dessert lists.
